raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "bregman-learning" %}
{% set version = "0.0.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/bregman_learning-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 47f2e2bae4a985c1cd4e12c4c058cbac90c70746c74647843ef247b1998ccbb1

build:
  skip: true  # [py<310]
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=30.3.0
    - wheel
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - pytorch >=1.12.0
    - numpy ==1.26  # [win]
    - numpy >=1.22  # [not win]
    - python-igraph
    - torch-simplify

test:
  imports:
    - bregman
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/TJHeeringa/bregman-learning
  summary: A pytorch extension providing the Bregman optimizers
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - TJHeeringa

about.summary: A pytorch extension providing the Bregman optimizers
